full_name: Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit (BA) -- 'Gemeindedaten aus der Beschaeftigungsstatistik' (Pendlerstatistik: Wohnort/Arbeitsort/Pendler nach Gemeinden)
_note: Live-verified 2026-08-25: https://statistik.arbeitsagentur.de/Statistikdaten/Detail/202506/iiia6/beschaeftigung-sozbe-gemband/gemband-dlk-0-202506-xlsx.xlsx (period 202506, Stichtag 30.06.2025) downloads a real, keyless, single national .xlsx (no per-Kreis split, unlike ../ba/'s AMK zips) whose 'Gemeindedaten' sheet has 11,832 real data rows (11,836 total incl. header/footer), each keyed by an 8-digit AGS ('Schl. Nr.') that equals GISCO's LAU_ID (some rows are 5-digit Kreis/Land aggregate rows mixed into the same sheet -- filtered out by AGS length, see loader.py). Real column layout (row 7 numbers 1-13, verified against merged-cell headers in rows 4-6): col C='Wohnort' (residents employed, SvB am Wohnort total), cols D-J=sex/nationality/age breakdowns of Wohnort (not wired here), col K='Arbeitsort' (SvB am Arbeitsort total -- matches ../ba's AMK 'jobsTotal' figure exactly: Hamburg AGS 02000000 = 1,084,974 in both sources, same Stichtag 30.06.2025, confirming internal consistency across BA's two independent Beschaeftigungsstatistik products), col L='Wohnort gleich Arbeitsort' (same-Gemeinde workers), col M='Einpendler' (in-commuters), col N='Auspendler' (out-commuters), col O='Zahl der Betriebe' (not wired here). Cross-check for Hamburg: Arbeitsort (1,084,974) approx= WohnortGleichArbeitsort (677,491) + Einpendler (406,965) = 1,084,456 (off by 518, a real small residual/rounding across BA's own sub-tables, not a parsing bug); Wohnort (828,887) approx= WohnortGleichArbeitsort (677,491) + Auspendler (151,344) = 828,835 (off by 52). Direction sanity-check: Hamburg (large city) shows Einpendler >> Auspendler (406,965 vs 151,344, i.e. a large net in-commute, as expected for a major employment center); a small suburban Gemeinde in Hamburg's real metro AOI, Pinneberg-Stadt (AGS 01056039, Schleswig-Holstein), shows the opposite: Auspendler (15,755) >> Einpendler (10,648), i.e. most residents commute OUT to work elsewhere -- the expected suburban pattern, confirming the real cross-tab direction is sane at both ends.

features.definition: Total number of employees subject to social-insurance contributions (sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschaeftigte) whose workplace (Arbeitsort) is in this Gemeinde, Stichtag 30.06, from BA's 'Gemeindedaten aus der Beschaeftigungsstatistik' report -- a real, independent BA product from ../ba's AMK 'jobsTotal', though verified to match it numerically for the same Stichtag (see schema note).
Total number of sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschaeftigte who live (Wohnort) in this Gemeinde, regardless of workplace, Stichtag 30.06 -- Germany's real LODES-RAC equivalent at Gemeinde level.
Sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschaeftigte whose residence (Wohnort) and workplace (Arbeitsort) are both in this same Gemeinde, Stichtag 30.06.
In-commuters: sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschaeftigte who work in this Gemeinde but live elsewhere, Stichtag 30.06.
Out-commuters: sozialversicherungspflichtig Beschaeftigte who live in this Gemeinde but work elsewhere, Stichtag 30.06.
